record.question: __________ is done through deficiency check i.e while assembling and analysing the record, note should be made of all deficiency. This can be done on a form specially designed for the purpose.
record.explanation: Answer A: Quantitative Analysis. Quantitative analysis checks whether required forms and elements are present, often using a deficiency slip while assembling the record. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
